exact_delta: One extension of existing len64 guard with existing E.C.P.Valid; all remaining bytes identical. Public spec unchanged.

reasoning.bounds: For admitted nonempty64 span, Evaluation_Pending.Valid requires First in Arena range and Length-1<=Arena.Last-First. Every byte-scan offset and both original digest offsets are inside the same64-byte span; additions remain at most Arena.Last and hence Count.Last. No new precondition or caller cap.
reasoning.existing_hex_semantics: Original lowercase hex validation and Nibble conversion loops are byte-identical. Existing zero-result behavior for wrong length or invalid digits is unchanged.
reasoning.invalid_span_no_authorization: Only private Digest call is Project_Alternatives for SQL column7. Project_Alternatives does not modify SQL. Decode_Into leaves Status Malformed unless final Parsed_Spans_Valid holds; Cells validates every alternative SQL cell span with unchanged S.Span_Valid. Invalid nonempty64 SQL_Text span therefore cannot become Parsed merely because Digest returns zeros. Raw_Span wrong-kind empty handling is unchanged.
reasoning.cost: Existing Valid is an expression of scalar tests/subtractions; no new loops, allocations, copies, snapshots or rescans.
reasoning.limits: These are independently checked source implications, not a GNATprove or execution result. Fresh strict target/caller proof and original malformed/end-point/valid decoding controls remain required.

numeric_offset_oracle.scope: Only constant offset arithmetic checked through JACKAL; not a code-correctness proof.
